collection.title: SEAT Toledo 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A SEAT Toledo 2005 to 2009 requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, we also have rear blade for this Toledo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
